name: meter-roncesvalles-day
js: (() => {const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP,s=C.parkingMeterStats;console.log('[ride-check] meter placement '+JSON.stringify({source:s.sourceCount,placed:s.placed,rejected:s.rejected}));if(s.sourceCount!==776||s.placed<100)throw new Error('Parking meter layer missing');const p=s.sites.find(r=>r.id==='5019-1022');if(!p)throw new Error('Photographed Roncesvalles machine was rejected');window.__meter=p;const x=p.x+Math.sin(p.yaw)*3.5,z=p.z+Math.cos(p.yaw)*3.5;a.teleportTo(x,z,Math.atan2(p.x-x,p.z-z));a.selectCamera('pov',true);const mesh=a.scene.getObjectByName('StreetProps_parkingMeter');if(mesh&&mesh.geometry.index&&mesh.geometry.index.count/3>200)throw new Error('High-poly source shipped');console.log('[ride-check] photo machine '+JSON.stringify(p));})()
